title: Abusive Robe / Flattery Robe
summary: A robe enchant system that uses Tokens of Honor to add Neev enchants to the Abusive Robe and the Flattery Robe.

blocks.text: A system that adds Neev enchants to the [ITEM:15147|Abusive Robe] and the [ITEM:15146|Flattery Robe] with [ITEM:6919|Token of Honor].
Dylan adds Neev enchants to the Abusive Robe and the Flattery Robe.
A robe can get up to 2 enchants, in the order slot 4 → slot 3.

blocks.title: Robes Only
blocks.text: Dylan also handles the Prontera badges, but this page covers only the Abusive Robe and Flattery Robe enchants.

blocks.title: Must Be Equipped
blocks.text: Enchanting and resetting require the robe to be equipped in the armor slot.
Robe enchants have no category choice: one of the Neev options below is given at random.

blocks.title: About the Rates
blocks.text: According to the script, every stat category has the same rate structure: overall, Lv 1 is about 8.65%, Lv 2 about 5.94% and Lv 3 about 2.08%.

blocks.title: Effects by Level
blocks.text: Neev Lv 1, Lv 2 and Lv 3 differ in the required refine level and the extra bonus. See the in-game item description for the exact values.
Dylan resets the enchants on the Abusive Robe or the Flattery Robe.

rows: Only robes with both slots enchanted
All enchants on it are reset
Refine level and socketed cards are kept

blocks.title: No Partial Reset
blocks.text: A robe can be reset only when both slots are enchanted, and you cannot reset only some of the slots.

blocks.title: Random Options
blocks.text: Robe enchants have no category choice: one of the STR/AGI/INT/DEX/VIT/LUK Neevs is given at random.

blocks.title: Reset After Both Enchants
blocks.text: A reset is only possible when both slots are enchanted.

blocks.title: Check Your Materials
blocks.text: Enchanting needs 20 [ITEM:6919|Token of Honor] per slot, and a reset needs 10 [ITEM:6919|Token of Honor].
